verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents a first-party Tracking Plans feature to 'monitor and act on non-compliant event data at the source' and to 'catch issues in transit, then fix and filter data before it impact downstream teams', plus in-flight validation of bad data before warehouse load. This covers the core of flagging and blocking violating events. Missing for 10: detailed docs on enforcement modes (explicit block vs. quarantine vs. flag-and-forward and where violations land), and independent or hands-on corroboration that enforcement works as claimed.
